objective: Demonstrate removal of artificial preservatives through memorable product proof.
businessContext: Category food imagery normally optimizes appetite appeal.
strategy: Make visible decomposition the proof of a product formulation claim.
outcomes: The work gained major creative-industry recognition while deliberately creating polarizing, unappetizing imagery.
whatWorked: The creative mechanism made the product claim difficult to ignore.
whatFailed: Attention and awards do not establish incremental sales impact.
transferConditions: A counter-category visual can directly and truthfully prove a valued product change.
nonTransferConditions: Do not trade core category appeal for shock without measuring commercial effects.
